import openpyxl, glob, os, re, collections, math
meta = {}
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx', read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws=wb.active
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
for r in rows[1:]:
    sid=str(r[0]).strip()
    meta[sid]=(r[2],r[3])
carrier=set(k for k,v in meta.items() if v[1]=='Carrier')
print('carrier metadata', len(carrier), sorted(carrier))
# map filenames sample part
files=sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx'))
carr_files=[]
for f in files:
    base=os.path.basename(f)
    m=re.search(r'CHIP_(.+?)\\.xlsx"'$'"', base)
    sample=m.group(1) if m else base
    if sample in carrier:
        carr_files.append((sample,f))
print('carrier files',len(carr_files),[s for s,f in carr_files])
# aggregate distributions
vals=collections.Counter(); so=collections.Counter(); eff=collections.Counter(); zyg=collections.Counter(); classif=collections.Counter(); inchip=collections.Counter(); filtercol=collections.Counter()
vaf_types=collections.Counter(); vaf_nonref_types=collections.Counter(); missing_clin=collections.Counter(); clin_by_zyg=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
nrows=0
for sample,f in carr_files:
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(f, read_only=False, data_only=True)
    ws=wb.active
    rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    hdr=rows[1]
    for r in rows[2:]:
        d={hdr[i]:r[i] for i in range(min(len(hdr),len(r))) if hdr[i] is not None}
        nrows+=1
        z=d.get('Zygosity'); so[d.get('Sequence Ontology (Combined)')]+=1; eff[d.get('Effect (Combined)')]+=1; zyg[z]+=1
        cl=d.get('Classification'); classif[cl]+=1
        inchip[d.get('In_CHIP')]+=1
        filtercol[d.get('Filter')]+=1
        vaf=d.get('Variant Allele Freq')
        if z=='Reference':
            vaf_types['ref:'+str(type(vaf).__name__)+':'+('None' if vaf is None else 'notnone')]+=1
        else:
            vaf_nonref_types[z]+=1
            if vaf is not None:
                try:
                    fv=float(vaf)
                    vals[z]+=1
                except Exception as e: pass
            else:
                vals['nonref_'+str(z)+'_missing']+=1
            if cl is None:
                missing_clin[z]+=1
            clin_by_zyg[z][cl]+=1
print('nrows',nrows)
print('zyg',zyg)
print('vaf nonref types',vaf_nonref_types)
print('vaf ref types',vaf_types)
print('so',so)
print('eff',eff)
print('classif',classif)
print('missing_clin_by_zyg',missing_clin)
print('inchip',inchip)
print('filter',filtercol)
print('clin_by_zyg')
for k,v in clin_by_zyg.items(): print(k, v)
